name: RESTful API Design
description: RESTful API Design standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-API-REST applies.

rules.title: Model REST resources with consistent nouns and HTTP methods
rules.detail: Use resource-oriented URLs and standard method semantics; avoid action verbs in paths unless the operation is not naturally resource-oriented.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Model REST resources with consistent nouns and HTTP methods.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Model REST resources with consistent nouns and HTTP methods.

rules.title: Use HTTP status codes consistently
rules.detail: Distinguish success, validation, authentication, authorization, conflict, not-found, rate-limit and server errors using agreed status semantics.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use HTTP status codes consistently.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use HTTP status codes consistently.

rules.title: Return structured machine-readable errors
rules.detail: Errors expose stable application/error codes, safe user-facing context and correlation identifiers; never expose stack traces or secrets.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Return structured machine-readable errors.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Return structured machine-readable errors.

rules.title: Standardize pagination, filtering and sorting
rules.detail: List endpoints define bounded page size, deterministic ordering and consistent query parameter conventions.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Standardize pagination, filtering and sorting.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Standardize pagination, filtering and sorting.

rules.title: Design write operations for duplicate and concurrency behavior
rules.detail: Use idempotency keys, conditional requests, unique constraints or version tokens where retries or concurrent updates can cause duplicate effects.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Design write operations for duplicate and concurrency behavior.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Design write operations for duplicate and concurrency behavior.

rules.title: Document the contract in OpenAPI
rules.detail: Request/response schemas, auth, status codes and examples must be represented in the API contract and kept aligned with implementation.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Document the contract in OpenAPI.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Document the contract in OpenAPI.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-API-REST applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of RESTful API Design to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: RESTful API Design is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses RESTful API Design failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
